isaSafety.title: ISA Safety Companion
isaSafety.subtitle: Highline safety reference
isaSafety.disclaimer: Based on ISA:21 (2023) and related standards. This app provides recommendations, the final decision is always yours. For definitive texts open the official ISA:21 PDF.

isa21Limits.title: ISA:21 Force Limits
isa21Limits.summary: Key safety limits for highline systems

serene.title: SERENE
serene.strongDetail: Anchor holds min 2× expected peak load. Target: 48 kN primary, 24 kN secondary.
serene.equalizedDetail: Load evenly distributed across all points. Sliding-X actively, BFK statically.
serene.redundantDetail: If 1 point fails, rest holds the load. Min 2 independent attachment points.
serene.efficientDetail: Angles between legs < 60° ideal, < 90° maximum. Above 120° = catastrophic.
serene.noExtensionDetail: If 1 leg fails, masterpoint stays in place → no shock load. Backup / limiting knots.

snareSane.title: SNARE SANE
snareSane.strengthDetail: Anchor holds min 2× expected peak load. Calculate max load (peak fall × safety factor 2).
snareSane.noAbrasionDetail: No sharp edges in load path. Visual check, padding at sharp edges.
snareSane.redundancyDetail: If 1 component fails, anchor still holds. Min 2 independent points.
snareSane.equalizationDetail: Load evenly distributed. Sliding-X actively, BFK statically.
snareSane.smallAnglesDetail: Angle between anchor legs < 60° ideal. 90° = per-leg 71%, 120° = 100%, > 120° = catastrophic.
snareSane.noExtensionDetail: Failure of one leg must not cause shock load. Backup / limiting knots.

nylonRule.title: Sub-40m Nylon Rule
nylonRule.summary: Webbing material compatibility with line length
nylonRule.hint: Sub-40m highline = mainline + backup + leash all PA (nylon). Static materials (PES, UHMWPE) generate 2-3× higher peak forces = risk of exceeding ISA:21 limit 12 kN.

wind.title: Wind Advisory
wind.summary: ISA thresholds for rig / derig decision
wind.hint: Watch Ventusky, Windy or Open-Meteo. Storm approach = derig immediately (electrostatic risk).

rlt.title: Recommended Lifetime (RLT)
rlt.summary: Recommended webbing lifetime by type and material
rlt.hint: Days = exposure to environment (UV, rain), NOT from manufacture date. Storage doesn't count.
